title: Canonical wedge-preserving comparison of exterior sheaf constructions
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M a sheaf of O_X-modules, and n a natural number. The sectionwise identity on exterior powers [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power] induces an isomorphism exteriorSheaf M n ≅ exteriorPower M n from the earlier construction to the upstream construction. For every open U and tuple a of n sections of M on U, its hom sends exteriorSheafSection M n U a to wedge a, and its inverse sends wedge a back. Consequently the upstream extensionality theorem for internal dual sections [def-pur-sheaf-hom] transports to the earlier construction.

source.place: Tag 03CY, lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules (sheafification functor and adjunction); exterior-power universal property and exteriorPower_map_ιMulti. Comparison proof written by C6.

proof.text: The old exterior presheaf and the upstream exteriorPower presheaf have the same sectionwise modules. The old restriction is characterized uniquely on pure wedges, and the upstream restriction satisfies that characterization by exteriorPower_map_ιMulti. Thus the identities form a presheaf isomorphism, proved by exteriorPower.linearMap_ext.

Apply the module-sheafification functor to that explicitly constructed isomorphism. Naturality of the adjunction unit, evaluated on a pure wedge, says its hom sends exteriorSheafSection a to wedge a. Apply the inverse and use hom_inv_id to obtain the inverse formula. No existence witness is chosen.

For dual sections q and r on U in the old encoding, precompose with the inverse comparison on the over-open site. The inverse wedge formula translates the hypothesis to the upstream all-subopen wedge hypothesis. Apply exteriorSheaf_dual_ext to conclude the precompositions agree. The inverse comparison remains an isomorphism under the forgetful and over-open restriction functors, hence is epi; cancel it to obtain q=r.

theorem exteriorSheafIsoExteriorPower_hom_wedge (M : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin n → M.val.obj (op U)) :
    (exteriorSheafIsoExteriorPower M n).hom.val.app (op U)
        (exteriorSheafSection M n U a) = wedge a
